description: List every CTA on a blog article individually, each with its raw `anchor` object — the per-CTA counterpart to get_blog_article's ctas[] projection. Use this to find the exact ctaId to pass to blog_cta_update/blog_cta_delete, or to see which anchor slots (the single `end` slot, and which `after_h2` indices) are already taken before calling blog_cta_add. `sectionCount` is an approximate `<h2>` count in the article body — a hint, not authoritative; verify against get_blog_article's content for an article with unusual nesting.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

name: blog_cta_list
